csv_project_name: AE for Electrical Grid Security Feeder 14
csv_scope_of_work: Central Washington University seeks funding to replace Feeder #14 on the south section of campus that primarily supports our campus data center in Samuelson Hall. The data center is the central hub of sensitive and student, faculty and staff information, as well as the primary source of distribution for our networking across campus. Several of our feeders have exceeded their 30-year life span and introduce a high potential risk for failure. Feeder #14 is one of these critical systems of ensuring ongoing campus operations. In addition to the data center, feeder #14 will also be the primary power path for our second geothermal facility. Over the course of the next 15-20 years, CWU anticipates nearly 500% growth in electrical demand to support its geothermal campus conversion.
